4136.text: The prompt audit uses the task system properly: tasks created in the right place (the session log), with the Task class revamped for sessions
Decide whether the auditing Haiku gets the whole project to judge done-ness; a surface pass with no implementation reading for the non-review case
Make prompt structuring real time for every future prompt, reliable and without context
Look into the existing prompt refine system; reuse it or make a separate quick refine process
Decide where prompt audit results are stored (separate file is fine; worry about session file size; reference the prompt by its id/line in the raw log)
Document for masterminds and minions when to create a task (not every tool call)
A more explicit planning phase; use projects to plan and list the tasks to check off
Only the owner's own prompts are audited, never agent-to-agent; a surefire filter over the log
Pass 1 must get the shape right; red-flag missing or invented tasks
Sonnet and/or Opus review the Haiku's judgment calls
Do not auto-add found tasks to completed sessions; keep the audit separate
A Sonnet reviewer per session judges which items were done; undone ones listed as prioritized loose ends
Keep each Haiku call under 100k tokens
Run the audit over the last week, or month or two
A map of every past audit / prompt refinement / loose-ends effort, linked from CLAUDE.md or nearby; use past audits' analysis
Make session data better: add tasks, organize into categories and priorities
Document the whole audit system; know what a day/week audit costs and how good it is
Addressing prompts accurately the first time becomes a default instruction in CLAUDE.md
Evolve the Haiku brief and output format over time
Capture the essence of each ask (paraphrase), not verbatim and not ignored
Haiku asks per prompt whether something should be written in a doc, proposing a note for a specific file (not auto-written)
A feedback loop between the mastermind designing the audit and the Sonnet reviewer

The owner can see every working system; everything indexed, never unfindable

A readme-read tool that logs each read to the session log, done by node

Give the owner an overview of these asks

An overview of every role, the skills it needs, how they are defined and loaded
One generic log tool writing to session.jsonl (spawns logged); a minion studies the best way to log

Write down the item system's future (server-side instantiation) and map the item system

Skill-like tools: a tool's answer carries instructions; a help method on the item tool
Tool-based prompt injection (pre-tool-use reminders); firm sequences run as code loops, not reminders
